core: Amino acid and oligopeptide plasma membrane transport
qualifier: neutral and imino amino acids, proton-coupled peptide carriers
name: Neutral and imino amino acid and oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members are transport of neutral/imino amino acids (glycine, proline, histidine, tryptophan; Hartnup and iminoglycinuria defects) and proton-coupled di/oligopeptide transport, unlike confusables centred on cystine/urate carriers or branched-chain amino acid import.

qualifier: entry, uncoating and reverse transcription
name: HIV entry, uncoating and reverse transcription
rationale: All members are the early HIV life-cycle steps from virion binding through minus- and plus-strand DNA synthesis, whereas confusables cover integration, APOBEC3G restriction or Nef/Vpu host-protein downregulation.

qualifier: respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
name: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern phagocyte killing of bacteria and fungi via superoxide/ROS generation and degranulation, distinguishing it from confusables about neutrophil chemotaxis, recruitment, formyl peptide and complement receptor signaling.

qualifier: protein targeting to centrosome and cell cortex
name: Centrosome positioning and protein targeting to centrosome and cortex
rationale: Members are establishment and maintenance of centrosome location and protein localization to centrosome and cell cortex, unlike confusables about chromosome cohesion, spindle orientation or mitotic progression.

qualifier: glucose and fatty acid uptake
name: Insulin- and adiponectin-regulated glucose and fatty acid uptake
rationale: Members cover insulin-stimulated GLUT4 glucose import, insulin receptor recycling/clearance, adiponectin signaling and control of fatty acid uptake and oxidation, unlike confusables on insulin secretion, glucagon/gluconeogenesis or lipolysis.

qualifier: p53 and mTORC1 control, lactate fermentation
name: p53- and mTORC1-linked control of glycolysis and lactate production
rationale: Members regulate glycolysis, pentose-phosphate shunt, nucleotide catabolism and lactate fermentation together with p53 and mTORC1 programmes, distinguishing them from HIF-driven, FOXO or fructose-bisphosphate confusables.

qualifier: RPIA and TALDO1 deficiencies
name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and its enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Members are non-oxidative PPP interconversions and the RPIA and TALDO1 deficiency reactions, unlike confusables on xylulose/glucuronate, galactose or fructose metabolism.

qualifier: gastrointestinal and urinary tract
name: Gastric function and gut and urinary smooth muscle motility
rationale: Members concern stomach function, peristalsis, GI and urinary tract smooth muscle contraction and micturition, unlike confusables on enteric nervous system development, generic smooth muscle relaxation or reproductive smooth muscle.

name: Regulation of cilium assembly and disassembly
rationale: All three members control building or resorbing the cilium, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport or centrosome/microtubule organization.

qualifier: elongation, peroxisomal beta-oxidation and ether lipid synthesis
name: Very-long-chain fatty acid elongation, peroxisomal beta-oxidation and ether lipids
rationale: Members cover VLCFA elongation and acyl-CoA synthesis, acyl-CoA oxidase peroxisomal beta-oxidation (ALD, pristanoyl-CoA), PUFA metabolism and plasmalogen/wax synthesis, unlike confusables on alpha/omega-oxidation, peroxisome biogenesis or sterol synthesis.

qualifier: oncogenic RAS and RAF1 mutants
name: Oncogenic RAS and RAF1 mutant MAPK cascade activation
rationale: All members describe MAP2K/MAPK activation, including downstream of RAS and RAF1 mutants, unlike confusables on Rap1/integrin signaling or wild-type RAF/MRAS activation.

qualifier: control of RAC1 and CDC42
name: Ephrin, ROBO and DCC guidance signaling to RAC1/CDC42
rationale: Members are ephrin, SLIT-ROBO and netrin-DCC guidance pathways converging on RAC1/CDC42 activation or inactivation, unlike confusables centred on RHOA, L1 or commissural pathfinding outcomes.

qualifier: receptor activation and Ca2+-driven signaling in LTP
name: NMDA receptor activation and signaling in long-term potentiation
rationale: Members cover NMDA receptor assembly, glutamate gating, Ca2+-driven Ras/RAC1 signaling and LTP, unlike confusables on postsynaptic structural plasticity, spines or BDNF signaling.

qualifier: priming, polymerase switching and strand elongation
name: DNA replication priming, polymerase switching and strand elongation
rationale: Members are the replication fork steps of initiation, primer synthesis, polymerase switching, elongation and flap removal, unlike confusables on translesion synthesis, repair gap-filling or origin unwinding.

qualifier: GPCR agonists thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin
name: Platelet GPCR signaling by thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin
rationale: Members are G-protein-coupled receptor pathways regulating platelet activation, unlike confusables on GPVI/collagen adhesion, degranulation or integrin cytoskeletal signaling.

qualifier: trabeculation and cardiomyocyte proliferation
name: Ventricular trabeculation and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: Members concern trabecular myocardium formation and ventricular cardiomyocyte development/proliferation, unlike confusables on heart tube, second heart field, compact myocardium or endocardium.

qualifier: islet insulin/glucagon secretion and insulin action
name: Islet hormone secretion and insulin action in glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members span beta-cell insulin secretion (KATP, incretins, FFAR1, glucokinase), glucagon signaling, insulin receptor action/GLUT4 and glycogen control, unlike confusables on adipose lipid storage, thermogenesis or gluconeogenic transcription.

qualifier: deamination and phosphorolysis (ADA, PNP)
name: Purine nucleoside catabolism by deamination and phosphorolysis
rationale: Members are breakdown of adenosine, inosine, AMP/IMP and deoxypurines including ADA and PNP defects and allantoin, unlike confusables on purine salvage or pyrimidine/deoxynucleotide catabolism.

qualifier: SMO-GLI processing with proteasomal developmental signaling crosstalk
name: Hedgehog SMO-GLI transduction and proteasomal developmental signaling crosstalk
rationale: Members center on SMO activation and proteasomal GLI processing/degradation alongside proteasome-linked regulation of DVL, NOTCH4, SLIT/ROBO and nuclear receptor signaling, unlike confusables on Hh/Wnt ligand lipidation, planar polarity or Notch transcription.

qualifier: macrophage and osteoclast differentiation, bone resorption
name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption
rationale: Members cover CSF production and signaling, monocyte/macrophage and osteoclast differentiation, bone remodeling and marrow cell homeostasis, unlike confusables on macrophage fusion/DAP12 or granulopoiesis.

qualifier: SOS-mediated and oncogenic RAS signaling
name: SOS-mediated Ras activation and oncogenic RAS-MAPK signaling
rationale: Members are positive Ras signal transduction via SHC/SOS, RAS and MAP2K mutants, RSK and p38 outputs, unlike confusables on RAS GAPs, NF1 loss or ERK inactivation.

qualifier: cancer mutants, fusions and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are constitutive signaling by mutant, amplified or fused KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ERBB2/EGFR, FGFR and ALK and their kinase-inhibitor binding/resistance, unlike confusables on wild-type RTK or cytokine receptor signaling.

qualifier: CYP oxidation and sulfonation of xenobiotics and plant compounds
name: Xenobiotic and phytochemical biotransformation by CYP oxidation and sulfonation
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic, toxin, alkaloid, terpenoid and steroid metabolism via cytochrome P450 oxidation and cytosolic sulfonation, unlike confusables on FMO oxidation, acetylation/methylation or paracetamol handling.

qualifier: ovarian follicle development
name: Gonadotropin secretion control of ovarian follicle development
rationale: Members regulate FSH/LH secretion and ovarian follicle development, unlike confusables on activin/Sertoli testis biology or ovulation and luteal events.

qualifier: microglial activation
name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta production and clearance
rationale: Members concern microglial activation, proliferation and cytotoxicity together with APP processing, amyloid fibril formation, amyloid-beta clearance and tangle assembly, unlike confusables on apoptotic cell engulfment, DAP12 or oxidized LDL responses.
